gripOrHq.title: Glacier
gripOrHq.rulesText: Rezzing Glacier cost 1 agenda point, in addition to the normal cost. *End the run. *End the run. [1]: Move Glacier to the outermost position of any other data fort. Use this ability only at the start of a run. You may use this ability even if Glacier is unrezzed, in which case, you reveal it.

gripOrHq.title: Entrapment
gripOrHq.rulesText: *If you pay [2], Runner is now encountering the outermost piece of rezzed ice on a data fort of your choice, instead of passing Entrapment. The run is now considered to be a run on that data fort. If there is no rezzed ice on that fort, Runner is considered to have passed the last piece of ice on that fort.

gripOrHq.title: Theorem Proof
gripOrHq.rulesText: If Runner accesses Theorem Proof, he or she does not score it, but instead may install it as a 2 MU program that has the ability "A: Score Theorem Proof" but is removed from the game if it leaves play in any other way.

gripOrHq.title: Rockerboy Promotion
gripOrHq.rulesText: Put [15] from the bank on Rockerboy Promotion when you rez it. When all the bits have been removed, trash Rockerboy Promotion. A: Take [3] from Rockerboy Promotion.

heapOrArchives.title: Puzzle
heapOrArchives.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Badtimes
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Play only if Runner is tagged. Runner's MU is reduced by 2 until end of turn.

heapOrArchives.title: Corporate Shuffle
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Draw five cards, then shuffle a card stored in HQ into R&D. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

heapOrArchives.title: Satellite Monitors
heapOrArchives.rulesText: At the start of each of your turns, you may roll a die for each run Runner made during his or her last turn. For each 1, give Runner a tag.

heapOrArchives.title: Strategic Planning Group
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Whenever you draw one or more cards, draw an extra card. Then place one of the drawn cards on the bottom of R&D. Only one unique card of a particular name can be in play at a time. If for some reason more than one is in play, trash all but one.

heapOrArchives.title: London City Grid
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Runner must pay [1], in addition to the normal cost, to use each subroutine of a noisy icebreaker during runs on this fort. Rez a region when you install it. Install a region only if you can pay to rez it. Only one region may be installed in each fort. Trash older ones.

heapOrArchives.title: Street Enforcer
heapOrArchives.rulesText: At the start of each run on this data fort, Runner loses [X], where X is equal to the number of tags Runner has.

heapOrArchives.title: Self-Destruct
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Install Self-Destruct only in a subsidiary data fort. [T]. Trash all other cards installed in or on this data fort. Do 1 Net damage for each card successfully trashed in this way. Use this ability only when Runner accesses Self-Destruct.

heapOrArchives.rulesText: Search the archives for any number of ice cards. Show those cards to Runner, then store them in HQ. Playing a double operation costs two consecutive actions this turn instead of one.

discardCards.title: Edited Shipping Manifests
discardCards.rulesText: Make a run on HQ. If run is successful, and the Corp has any credits when you would access HQ, do not access cards from HQ; instead, the Corp loses [1] and gives you a tag, and you gain [10].

discardCards.title: Restrictive Net Zoning
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a data fort when Restrictive Net Zoning is installed. The Corp must pay [2], in addition to the normal cost, to install ice on that fort.

discardCards.title: Loan from Chiba
discardCards.rulesText: Gain [12] when Loan from Chiba is installed. At the start of each of your turns, lose [1]. If Loan from Chiba leaves play, pay [10] or lose the game. You may trash Loan from Chiba at the end of any of your turns.

discardCards.title: Forged Activation Orders
discardCards.rulesText: Choose a piece of ice. The Corp either rezzes that piece of ice or trashes it.

discardCards.title: Core Command: Jettison Ice
discardCards.rulesText: Play only if you made a successful run on HQ this turn. Pay the rez cost of a piece of rezzed ice to trash it.

discardCards.title: Startup Immolator
discardCards.rulesText: [T]: Pay the rez cost of a piece of ice to trash that piece of ice. Use this ability only if you have just broken all the subroutines of that piece of ice.
